_comment: The dominant collision risk here is cline-skill-creator, not an unrelated
skill: both are about authoring skills, and they share most of their
vocabulary. So most negatives are queries that ought to fire IT instead —
scaffolding, frontmatter, a skill that will not trigger, packaging. If the
eval set cannot tell the two apart, neither score means anything.
The split that actually separates them: this skill is about getting
knowledge OUT OF A SOURCE with its evidence intact. cline-skill-creator is
about the SKILL FILE FORMAT and whether it fires.
Needs `cline` on PATH and `cline auth`. Not yet executed — see docs/pitfalls.md
on reporting what was not measured rather than skipping it silently.
